name: Guizhou Bailing Group Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Guizhou Bailing Group Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, produces, and sells medicines in China. It operates through four segments: Industrial, Commerce, Medical institutions, and Others. The company offers medicines in various forms, including tablets, tinctures, decoctions, capsules, granules, syrups, powders, pills, dews, pastes, and sprays, as well as wines and honey. Its products are used for cardiovascular, cerebrovascular, cough, cold, gynecological, and pediatric areas. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Anshun, China.
